record_type_quote: The original study was conducted on students from Southeast Asia. Our study uses a significantly larger sample of college students in the United States.

targets.evidence_quote: In this study, we carry out a methodological replication of the research done by Choi et al. (2015) published in Information System Research.
targets.outcome_quote: Our replication results show that whereas most of the hypotheses supported by the original results on behavioral responses replicate with high consistency (8 out of 12 hypotheses), the results that deal with the effects of network commonality on perceived privacy invasion and perceived relationship bonding did not replicate (4 out of 12 hypotheses).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly report behavioral-response agreement and network-commonality disagreement. A failed manipulation does not override their mixed comparisons. Full reference unavailable.

reasoning: Title, DOI and two authors verified against publisher. Different US sample retests the Southeast Asian findings. Full PDF challenged; coded publisher-confirmed OpenAlex abstract only.
